node.statement: QRL-T3 (one-fiber lemma; audited SOUND). At scales M in [k, t]: a shared full M-fiber has M >= k points and pins the degree-< k codeword; the first-fiber map injects classes into the n/M fibers, so the CLASS-TOTAL is <= n/M. Closes the 87 M-not-dividing-k pairs (catch #111) — the supplier no other node provided; those pairs are also covered class-total by T1's binomial sums (n' in {4,8}).
